verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a per-role interview plan in Lever: no stages, no stored question banks, no per-interviewer focus areas, and no define-once-and-reuse templates. The only related item is an AI interview-question generator (lever-docs-27), which produces questions on demand. That is an adjacent feature, not a structured plan attached to a role. Interview transcripts and pipeline automation are different capabilities and do not carry over to this story.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused
